annotation.title_clean: Lineamientos recomendados para el uso de herramientas de inteligencia artificial en el sector público (Oficio conjunto MinSegpres–MinCiencia)
annotation.title_en: Recommended Guidelines for the Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools in the Public Sector
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio Secretaría General de la Presidencia; Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología, Conocimiento e Innovación (Chile)
named_instruments_referenced: Ley 19.628 sobre protección de la vida privada
Decreto N° 7 de 2023 (Norma Técnica de Seguridad de la Información y Ciberseguridad)
annotation.summary_en: Chilean joint official letter recommending non-binding guidelines to State administration bodies on using AI tools in the public sector: people-centred AI, non-discrimination, transparency and explainability, privacy and data use, cybersecurity compliance, and staff training. It is a first step toward a common framework, with monitoring by the Data Directorate.
key_provisions_or_claims: Assess whether AI is the most suitable solution and avoid arbitrary discrimination
Inform citizens of AI tools used, including chatbots, in clear language
Comply with Law 19.628 and avoid entering personal data into non-contracted generative AI
Comply with cybersecurity technical norms (Decrees 7 and 11 of 2023)
Data Directorate may request information to monitor compliance; staff training encouraged
